newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up despite inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up despite inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank rates ended higher on Thursday despite an inflow of 4.3 billion rupees on maturity of paper sold in an open market operation and dealers said rates would remain firm.
Overnight funds were traded at 17 percent throughout the day as the inflow could not keep pace with the market's borrowing needs, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
He said the market was expected to remain firm for the next few sessions after the Friday-Saturday weekend.
